name: Erythropoietic Protoporphyria

criteria.description: Immediate painful photosensitivity with burning and itching upon sun exposure
Increased free erythrocyte protoporphyrin levels in blood
Identification of pathogenic mutations in the FECH gene or ALAS2 gene
Histopathological findings consistent with porphyrin deposition
Red fluorescence of erythrocytes or plasma under Wood's lamp

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of characteristic photosensitivity symptoms plus elevated erythrocyte protoporphyrin levels or confirmatory genetic testing
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis is supported by clinical presentation, biochemical testing, and genetic confirmation.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Immediate painful photosensitivity with burning sensation
searchTerms: immediate painful sun sensitivity with burning
quick onset burning pain from sunlight

pathognomonic.symptomName: Non-blistering erythema and edema on sun-exposed skin
searchTerms: red swollen skin without blisters after sun

pathognomonic.symptomName: Chronic skin thickening and scarring on dorsal hands and face
searchTerms: chronic thickened and scarred skin on hands and face

common.symptomName: Mild jaundice due to protoporphyrin accumulation
searchTerms: mild yellow skin tint from pigment buildup

common.symptomName: Abdominal discomfort or mild gastrointestinal upset
searchTerms: belly discomfort or mild stomach upset
stones in gallbladder due to pigment

rare.symptomName: Neuropathic pain unrelated to sun exposure
searchTerms: nerve pain not related to sun
chronic nerve pain independent of sun exposure

laboratory: Normal or mildly elevated liver function tests
Fluorescence emission peak at 634 nm in plasma
imaging: Ultrasound showing gallstones or hepatomegaly in some cases
other: Wood's lamp fluorescence of erythrocytes or plasma

distinguishingFeatures: Delayed blistering photosensitivity rather than immediate pain
Delayed onset rash after sun exposure
No biochemical abnormalities in porphyrin metabolism

redFlags: Severe, immediate burning pain on minimal sun exposure
Progressive liver dysfunction or signs of hepatic failure
references: Anderson KE, et al. The porphyrias. Lancet. 2005;365(9455):241-252.
Balwani M, Desnick RJ. The porphyrias: advances in diagnosis and treatment. Blood. 2012;120(23):4496-4504.
Whatley SD, Badminton MN, et al. Erythropoietic protoporphyria: recent advances. Mol Genet Metab. 2008;94(2):121-128.
